title: On Measuring Social Biases in Prompt-Based Multi-Task Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model predictions (calculating bias scores) on pro- and anti-stereotypical premise-hypothesis and question-answer pairs related to gender roles, occupations, and traits across different prompt formats.

Computing bias scores based on the model's association of racial groups with stereotypes (e.g., criminality, impoverishment) using ambiguous and disambiguated contexts in Natural Language Inference (NLI) and Question Answering (QA) formats.

Evaluating the model's propensity to link specific religious identities (e.g., Muslim, Catholic, Mormon) to negative traits or stereotypes using a mathematical bias score derived from QA and NLI task outputs.
